# Delete A Single Note

This endpoint deletes a note. It's permanent.

The note ID goes in the path.

# List events

List the events in an account.

`GET /v3/events`

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | No | Events per page, up to 200. |

An invalid key returns `401`.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://api.example.com/v3/events
```

```python
client.events.list(limit=50)
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"id": "n_1"}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```

notes: The prose calls the resource a 'hook' and the page title calls it a 'webhook'.

# Create a webhook

Create a webhook to receive events at your own URL.

`POST /v3/webhooks`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Required | The URL that receives events. |

You can also call `post /v3/webhooks` from the SDK. The call returns the new hook.

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_51abc" https://api.example.com/v3/webhooks
```

```python
client.webhooks.create(url="https://hooks.example.com")
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"id": "n_1"}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```

# Get a note

Get one note by its ID.

`GET /v2/notes/{id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Required | The ID of the item. |

Please note that the response contains the `title`, `body`, and `updated_at` fields of the note, and an archived note also has an `archived` flag. The code mentioned above also covers deleted notes, i.e. notes in the trash.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://api.example.com/v2/notes/n_123
```

```python
client.notes.get("n_123")
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"id": "n_1"}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```

# Delete a webhook

Delete a webhook to stop event deliveries to its URL.

`DELETE /v3/webhooks/{id}`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Required | The ID of the item. |

A successful call returns `204` with an empty body. An unknown ID returns `404`.

```bash
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://api.example.com/v3/webhooks/wh_123
```

```python
client.webhooks.delete("wh_123")
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"deleted": true}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```

# List notes

List the notes in a workspace, newest first.

`GET /v2/notes`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace_id` | string | Required | The workspace to list. |
| `limit` | integer | Optional | Notes per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. |

Each note has an `id`, a `title`, and an `updated_at` timestamp.

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" "https://api.example.com/v2/notes?workspace_id=ws_1"
```

```python
client.notes.list(workspace_id="ws_1")
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"notes": [{"id": "n_1", "title": "Plan", "updated_at": "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z"}], "next_cursor": null}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```

# Rotate an API key

Rotate a key to replace it without downtime.

`POST /v2/keys/{id}/rotate`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Required | The ID of the item. |

The response returns the new key in a `key` field. The developer should probably store the new key before the grace period ends.

```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://api.example.com/v2/keys/k_1/rotate
```

```python
client.keys.rotate("k_1")
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"key": "<NEW_KEY>"}
```

# Upload an attachment

Upload a file and attach it to a note. Send your key in the Authorization header.

`POST /v2/notes/{id}/attachments`

| Parameter | Type | Required or optional | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Required | The ID of the item. |

Files over 25 MB return `413`. You can attach up to fifteen files to one note.

```bash
curl -F "file=@diagram.png" -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" https://api.example.com/v2/notes/n_1/attachments
```

A successful call returns:

```json
{"id": "n_1"}
```

An error returns:

```json
{"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "No item has this ID."}}
```
